item.title: Man was found walking street with a golf club
item.description: By Ronan Judge A 25-year-old man had no “valid reason” he was allegedly seen walking with a golf club in Galway City, a court has heard. item.title: Accused pleads guilty to raping girl almost 50 years ago

item.title: Tonery’s comes tumbling down to make way for hotel
item.description: One of Galway’s best-known pubs has come tumbling down — to make way for a new hotel in Bohermore. Tonery’s Bar will be replaced by a 160-plus bedroom hotel that will be four floors high facing Bohermore road, with a further two storeys on the sloping site to the rear. item.description: Plans to transform a former mill building that is more than 200 years old into a new School of Law centre have been unveiled by the University of Galway. item.title: More than a quarter of its property not registered to Galway City Council
item.description: More than a quarter of Galway City Council’s identified property, including land, are not registered as being owned by the local authority — 16 years after City Hall started a registration of title exercise.
